dialogues.jp: ──プルルル
dialogues.en: --*ring*
dialogues.text: --*ring*

dialogues.jp: ──プルルルルルル
dialogues.en: --*ring ring*
dialogues.text: --*ring ring*

dialogues.jp: 「音夢ー、電話だぞー、早く出ろ！」
dialogues.en: "Nemu, the phone's ringing, hurry up!"
dialogues.text: "Nemu, the phone's ringing, hurry up!"

dialogues.jp: ──プルルル
dialogues.en: --*ring*
dialogues.text: --*ring*

dialogues.jp: ──プルルルルルル
dialogues.en: --*ring ring*
dialogues.text: --*ring ring*

dialogues.jp: 「……いないんだった」
dialogues.en: "...Right, she's not here."
dialogues.text: "...Right, she's not here."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、ベッドから跳ね起き、駆け足で玄関に向
かう。
dialogues.en: I jumped off my bed, and rushed towards the entranceawy.
dialogues.text: I jumped off my bed, and rushed towards the entranceawy.

dialogues.jp: 「はい、朝倉です」
dialogues.en: "Hello, Asakura residence."
dialogues.text: "Hello, Asakura residence."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 『あ、先輩ですか？　美春です』
dialogues.en: "Ah, is that you, senpai? It's Miharu."
dialogues.text: "Ah, is that you, senpai? It's Miharu."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「美春かよ。何の用だ？」
dialogues.en: "Miharu? What's up?"
dialogues.text: "Miharu? What's up?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
『先輩は、月城さんが学校休んだ理由、知って
　ます？』
dialogues.en: "Do you know why Tsukishiro-san's absent from school?"
dialogues.text: "Do you know why Tsukishiro-san's absent from school?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「知ってるけど……、そんなの学校に聞けよ」
dialogues.en: "I do, but... I'm not sure whether the whole school should."
dialogues.text: "I do, but... I'm not sure whether the whole school should."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
『いやぁ、風邪としか教えてもらえなくて。お
　見舞いに行こうかどうしようか迷ってまして』
dialogues.en:
"Nooo, I don't mean about how she's caught a cold. I mean
whether it'd be alright to visit her."
dialogues.text:
"Nooo, I don't mean about how she's caught a cold. I mean
whether it'd be alright to visit her."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、一昨日の雨でやられてさ。昨日、落ち
　着いたみたいだから、見舞いに行っても大丈
　夫だと思うぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, she got caught in the rain a two days ago...
yesterday, she seemed to have calmed down, so it'd probably
be alright."
dialogues.text:
"Well, she got caught in the rain a two days ago...
yesterday, she seemed to have calmed down, so it'd probably
be alright."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 『なんだか、見てきたような台詞ですね』
dialogues.en: "Wow, you sound like you've seen her already!"
dialogues.text: "Wow, you sound like you've seen her already!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……いろいろあってな」
dialogues.en: "...Stuff happened."
dialogues.text: "...Stuff happened."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
『先輩、一緒にお見舞い行きましょう。美春の
　学校が終わるまで待っててください』
dialogues.en:
"Senpai, let's go visit her today. Please wait till after I
finish school!"
dialogues.text:
"Senpai, let's go visit her today. Please wait till after I
finish school!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「なに、おい、勝手に決めるなよ」
dialogues.en: "Hey, wait a second, don't just decide by yourself!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, wait a second, don't just decide by yourself!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
『じゃ、お願いしますね。お見舞いに果物かご
　買って、迎えに行きますから。──では』
dialogues.en:
"So, let's meet up after school, and buy some fruits before
going to her house! I'd see you then!"
dialogues.text:
"So, let's meet up after school, and buy some fruits before
going to her house! I'd see you then!"

dialogues.jp: ──プツッ
dialogues.en: --*click*
dialogues.text: --*click*

dialogues.jp: 「おい、美春！　美春！」
dialogues.en: "Oy, Miharu! Miharu!!"
dialogues.text: "Oy, Miharu! Miharu!!"

dialogues.jp: たく、あいつめ。勝手に決めやがって……。
dialogues.en: Gah, that girl, just deciding things like that...
dialogues.text: Gah, that girl, just deciding things like that...

dialogues.jp: 「ま、俺も行く予定だったから、いいか」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I was planning to see her anyway, so I guess it'd be
fine."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I was planning to see her anyway, so I guess it'd be
fine."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、受話器を置いて、部屋に戻った。
dialogues.en:
Putting the receiver back onto the phone, I returned to my
room.
dialogues.text:
Putting the receiver back onto the phone, I returned to my
room.

dialogues.jp: そして、３時頃になると、美春が迎えに来た。
dialogues.en: Then, at 3 PM, I met up with Miharu.
dialogues.text: Then, at 3 PM, I met up with Miharu.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「へえ、じゃあ月城さんが育ててた花はダメに
　なっちゃったんですか……」
dialogues.en:
"Ehhh, so the plant Tsukishiro-san was growing can't be
saved..."
dialogues.text:
"Ehhh, so the plant Tsukishiro-san was growing can't be
saved..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ああ。おまけに人形もダメになってな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah. The same goes for her doll."
dialogues.text: "Yeah. The same goes for her doll."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか……。そんなことが」
dialogues.en: "I see... so that's what happened."
dialogues.text: "I see... so that's what happened."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「だから、月城は随分落ち込んでいるみたいで
　さ……」
dialogues.en: "That's why she really seems depressed..."
dialogues.text: "That's why she really seems depressed..."

dialogues.jp:
本当は、午前中に見舞いに行こうと思っていた
のだけれど、昨日の月城の落ち込み様に、足を
運びそびれていた。
dialogues.en:
I kind of wanted to see her before this afternoon, but
remembering her crestfallen face, I couldn't get my legs to
move.
dialogues.text:
I kind of wanted to see her before this afternoon, but
remembering her crestfallen face, I couldn't get my legs to
move.

dialogues.jp: 「ところで、美春。ひとつ聞いていいか？」
dialogues.en: "By the way, Miharu, can I ask you something?"
dialogues.text: "By the way, Miharu, can I ask you something?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「なんでしょう？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「後ろのソレ、何？」
dialogues.en: "What's that thing following us?"
dialogues.text: "What's that thing following us?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「何って……、見ての通りじゃないですか」
dialogues.en: "What's... it's exactly what you think it is?"
dialogues.text: "What's... it's exactly what you think it is?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そろそろ無視を続けるのも限界ということだ
　な……」
dialogues.en: "It seems you couldn't ignore me any longer, eh..."
dialogues.text: "It seems you couldn't ignore me any longer, eh..."

dialogues.jp:
後ろで、くくくと笑う杉並がいるが、振り返り
たくはない。
dialogues.en:
I didn't bother to even acknowledging the snickering
Suginami behind me, by turning my head.
dialogues.text:
I didn't bother to even acknowledging the snickering
Suginami behind me, by turning my head.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「途中で、偶然会っちゃいまして。どこへ行く
　かと聞かれましたので、月城さんのお見舞い
　に行くと答えたら……」
dialogues.en:
"I met him on the way here. When I told him where I was
going, he said he wanted to visit Tsukishiro-san as well..."
dialogues.text:
"I met him on the way here. When I told him where I was
going, he said he wanted to visit Tsukishiro-san as well..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「知ってる人間が、病気で学校を休んでいるん
　だ。見舞いに行くのは当然だろう」
dialogues.en:
"It's a person I know, who's too sick to go to school. Of
course I'd go visit her."
dialogues.text:
"It's a person I know, who's too sick to go to school. Of
course I'd go visit her."

dialogues.jp: 杉並が、偉そうな声でそう言った。
dialogues.en: Suginami beat his chest proudly.
dialogues.text: Suginami beat his chest proudly.

dialogues.jp:
「確かに、去年俺が３日寝込んだ時も来てくれ
　たよな」
dialogues.en:
"Just like last year, when I was bedridden for three days,
huh."
dialogues.text:
"Just like last year, when I was bedridden for three days,
huh."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「当然だ。親友だからな」
dialogues.en: "Naturally. We are the closest of frends, after all."
dialogues.text: "Naturally. We are the closest of frends, after all."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……俺の横で、人が買ったばかりのＲＰＧを
　勝手に解いてたよな。３日通い詰めで」
dialogues.en:
"...You parked yourself in front of my TV and blasted
through all my RPGs for each and every one of those three
days."
dialogues.text:
"...You parked yourself in front of my TV and blasted
through all my RPGs for each and every one of those three
days."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「あの時は、金が無くて買えなかったんだ。大
　変ありがたかったぞ」
dialogues.en: "Of course, I was low on money during that period."
dialogues.text: "Of course, I was low on money during that period."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、まあ。お二人とも。今日は月城さんの
　お見舞いに行くんですから……」
dialogues.en:
"N, now now, you two. We're going to see Tsukishiro-san,
so..."
dialogues.text:
"N, now now, you two. We're going to see Tsukishiro-san,
so..."

dialogues.jp:
まあ、今さら取り立てて杉並に何かを言ったと
ころで何も変わりはしないだろう。
dialogues.en:
Oh well, no matter what Suginami does now anyway, it won't
be able to change the past.
dialogues.text:
Oh well, no matter what Suginami does now anyway, it won't
be able to change the past.

dialogues.jp:
そうこうしているうちに、俺達は月城邸の前ま
でやってきた。
dialogues.en: We quickly found ourselves in front of Tsukishiro Mansion.
dialogues.text: We quickly found ourselves in front of Tsukishiro Mansion.

dialogues.jp:
俺達は、いつものように瀬場さんに迎えられ、
リビングに通してもらった。
dialogues.en:
As always, we were greeted by Seiba-san, and whisked into
the living room.
dialogues.text:
As always, we were greeted by Seiba-san, and whisked into
the living room.

dialogues.jp:
だが月城は休んでいるとのことで、会うことは
できなかった。
dialogues.en:
And while she's doing that, it's pretty unreasonable for us
to go see her....
dialogues.text:
And while she's doing that, it's pretty unreasonable for us
to go see her....

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「タイミングの悪い時に来ちゃいましたね」
dialogues.en: "Our timing was pretty bad, it seems."
dialogues.text: "Our timing was pretty bad, it seems."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「仕方ないさ」
dialogues.en: "Oh well, it can't be helped."
dialogues.text: "Oh well, it can't be helped."

dialogues.jp:
そんな俺たちに気をつかってくれたのか、瀬場
さんが、せっかくなのでお茶でもいかがですか、
と誘ってくれた。
dialogues.en:
Before we even noticed, Seiba-san had already prepared tea
for us.
dialogues.text:
Before we even noticed, Seiba-san had already prepared tea
for us.

dialogues.jp: その間に月城が目を覚ますかも知れないし……。
dialogues.en:
Who knows where Tsukishiro's woken up since between
yesterday and now...
dialogues.text:
Who knows where Tsukishiro's woken up since between
yesterday and now...

dialogues.jp: 俺は、その好意に甘えることにした。
dialogues.en: I sipped the sweet-smelling drink, while thinking to myself.
dialogues.text: I sipped the sweet-smelling drink, while thinking to myself.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そうだな。俺は是非、セバスチャンの昔話を
　聞きたいな」
dialogues.en:
"Oh yes! I'd like to hear more about the legend of
Sebastian."
dialogues.text:
"Oh yes! I'd like to hear more about the legend of
Sebastian."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「昔話？　桃太郎とか、イソップとかですか？」
dialogues.en: "Legend? Like Momotaro, and Isopp?"
dialogues.text: "Legend? Like Momotaro, and Isopp?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「いや、セバスチャンは昔な──」
dialogues.en: "Not quite! Sebastian was formerly..."
dialogues.text: "Not quite! Sebastian was formerly..."

dialogues.jp: 杉並の言葉を｛さえぎ／遮｝るような、軽い咳払い。
dialogues.en: Interrupting Suginami's sentence with a small cough,
dialogues.text: Interrupting Suginami's sentence with a small cough,

dialogues.jp:
瀬場さんは、人差し指を口元に立て、ウィンク
した。
dialogues.en:
"Ahem, Suginami-sama, perhaps I should save that for the
next time we are alone..."
dialogues.text:
"Ahem, Suginami-sama, perhaps I should save that for the
next time we are alone..."

dialogues.jp: そして、その口元に当てた指が２本になる。
dialogues.en: Seiba-san put a finger to his lips, and winked.
dialogues.text: Seiba-san put a finger to his lips, and winked.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ふ、二人きりで……。光栄です」
dialogues.en: "W, when we're alone... with pleasure."
dialogues.text: "W, when we're alone... with pleasure."

dialogues.jp:
杉並は、なぜか頬を赤らめながら、嬉しそうに
そう言った。
dialogues.en: For some reason, his cheeks flushed red as he replied.
dialogues.text: For some reason, his cheeks flushed red as he replied.

dialogues.jp:
……どうもこの二人の会話はわからない。
…………まぁ、気にしないことにしよう。
dialogues.en:
...How much have these two been... talking... without my
knowledge? ......Well, whatever. Nothing to do with me.
dialogues.text:
...How much have these two been... talking... without my
knowledge? ......Well, whatever. Nothing to do with me.

dialogues.jp:
俺達の前に、綺麗な紅い色をした紅茶と、バター
のいい匂いがするホットビスケットが置かれた。
dialogues.en:
Seiba-san placed a set of aromatic hot biscuits with butter,
to go with the tea.
dialogues.text:
Seiba-san placed a set of aromatic hot biscuits with butter,
to go with the tea.

dialogues.jp:
瀬場さんは、遠い目をしながら、月城の家族の
話をしてくれた。
dialogues.en:
His eyes stared into the distance, perhaps to the past, as
he started to speak.
dialogues.text:
His eyes stared into the distance, perhaps to the past, as
he started to speak.

dialogues.jp:
月城の親父さんは、｛きょうじ／享司｝という名前で、月城家
の次男坊だったらしい。
dialogues.en:
Quite a story... a man who rejected wealth and safety for
freedom.
dialogues.text:
Quite a story... a man who rejected wealth and safety for
freedom.

dialogues.jp:
亨司さんは、親に決められた人生が嫌だと言っ
て勘当の身となり、この屋敷を出た、というこ
とだ。
dialogues.en:
If I had to make the same choice, I don't know which I would
choose.
dialogues.text:
If I had to make the same choice, I don't know which I would
choose.

dialogues.jp:
よくある話だ。どうして、金持ちの連中は、敷
かれたレールが嫌だというのだろうか。
dialogues.en:
Even if it was a straight an unwavering path, many different
trains would travel it, housing many different people, after
all...
dialogues.text:
Even if it was a straight an unwavering path, many different
trains would travel it, housing many different people, after
all...

dialogues.jp:
俺なら、せっかく敷いてあるレールに載せても
らうんだけどな。
dialogues.en:
"Indeed. Kyouji-sama married the circus's star act,
Sophie-sama, and gave life to the mistress soon after."
dialogues.text:
"Indeed. Kyouji-sama married the circus's star act,
Sophie-sama, and gave life to the mistress soon after."

dialogues.jp:
敷かれたレールの上でも、いろんな列車を走ら
せられると思うんだが、そんなのは庶民の考え
ということだろうか。
dialogues.en: "So a normal mixed Japanese, then."
dialogues.text: "So a normal mixed Japanese, then."

dialogues.jp: ……まぁ、そんなことはいいか。
dialogues.en:
"Although I did not see it myself, I heard that the mistress
was an energetic and cheerful young lady in her childhood
days."
dialogues.text:
"Although I did not see it myself, I heard that the mistress
was an energetic and cheerful young lady in her childhood
days."

dialogues.jp:
で、家を出た亨司さんは、ヨーロッパに行き、
そこで興行していたサーカスの一員になったら
しい。
dialogues.en:
"Since the tender age of 5, she was recruited as a dancer by
the circus, and gained mass popularity among the viewers."
dialogues.text:
"Since the tender age of 5, she was recruited as a dancer by
the circus, and gained mass popularity among the viewers."

dialogues.jp:
そのサーカスで花形だった月城の母さん、ソフィ
さんと出会い、結婚し、月城が産まれた……と
いうことだ。
dialogues.en:
"But, as it was a circus, it toured around the conuntry. The
mistress was never able to make friends, and always cried
about it."
dialogues.text:
"But, as it was a circus, it toured around the conuntry. The
mistress was never able to make friends, and always cried
about it."

dialogues.jp:
幼い頃の月城は、今とは比べられないほどに快
活で、サーカスの踊り子として人気を博してい
たらしい。
dialogues.en:
Seiba-san's eyes took on a look of loneliness, staring at
the ripples in his red tea.
dialogues.text:
Seiba-san's eyes took on a look of loneliness, staring at
the ripples in his red tea.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、サーカスというのは、全国を巡業するも
のなので、友達ができずに、いつも泣いていた。
dialogues.en:
"Having seen the mistress behave that way, Kyouji-sama and
Sophie-sama gave her a certain doll."
dialogues.text:
"Having seen the mistress behave that way, Kyouji-sama and
Sophie-sama gave her a certain doll."

dialogues.jp:
そんな月城に両親が与えたが、あの人形……ピ
ロスだった。
dialogues.en: "Which would be Piros?"
dialogues.text: "Which would be Piros?"

dialogues.jp:
ピロスとは、ギリシャ語で『友達』という意味
を持っているんだそうだ。
dialogues.en:
"In actual fact, Piros is a greek word, meaning "friend" in
it's native language."
dialogues.text:
"In actual fact, Piros is a greek word, meaning "friend" in
it's native language."

dialogues.jp:
その日から、ピロスは月城の唯一の友達になっ
た。
dialogues.en:
"From that day onwards, Piros became the mistress's one and
only friend."
dialogues.text:
"From that day onwards, Piros became the mistress's one and
only friend."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そうだったんですか……」
dialogues.en: "That's how it happened..."
dialogues.text: "That's how it happened..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「だが、しかし、所詮人形では、本当の友達に
　はならなかっただろうな」
dialogues.en:
"But, in the end, a mere doll cannot take the place of true
friends."
dialogues.text:
"But, in the end, a mere doll cannot take the place of true
friends."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「物言わぬ人形ではお嬢様の心を癒すことがで
　きなかったようです」
dialogues.en:
"The truth of that statement is unparalleled. A doll, which
could not even speak, could not heal the mistress's heart."
dialogues.text:
"The truth of that statement is unparalleled. A doll, which
could not even speak, could not heal the mistress's heart."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「お嬢様は、ついにご両親にご不満をぶつけら
　れたそうです」
dialogues.en:
"The mistress, in the end, became filled with anger at her
parents, and threw a temper tantrum at them."
dialogues.text:
"The mistress, in the end, became filled with anger at her
parents, and threw a temper tantrum at them."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「サーカスなどやっていなければ……か」
dialogues.en:
"In the end, the circus was never meant for
her...apparently."
dialogues.text:
"In the end, the circus was never meant for
her...apparently."

dialogues.jp:
『実際のところはわかりかねますが』と前置き
してから、瀬場さんは続ける。
dialogues.en: Seiba-san nodded his head gravely.
dialogues.text: Seiba-san nodded his head gravely.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「後日享司様とソフィ様は、公演中事故に遭わ
　れ、お亡くなりになられたのです」
dialogues.en:
"Kyouji-sama and Sophie-sama were distracted by the
mistress's harshness, and during a performance, met with a
fatal accident."
dialogues.text:
"Kyouji-sama and Sophie-sama were distracted by the
mistress's harshness, and during a performance, met with a
fatal accident."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「もしかして、月城さん、それを自分のせいだっ
　て思いこんでるんじゃ……」
dialogues.en: "You mean, Tsukishiro-san, then thought it was her fault..."
dialogues.text: "You mean, Tsukishiro-san, then thought it was her fault..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「それから、お嬢様はご自分の気持ちや、お考
　えでいらっしゃることを口にすることができ
　なくなったようです」
dialogues.en:
"Correct. Since then, the mistress would no longer let her
true feelings be known to others."
dialogues.text:
"Correct. Since then, the mistress would no longer let her
true feelings be known to others."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「自分の言葉が、両親を殺した……と」
dialogues.en: "Killing her parents, with her own words... eh."
dialogues.text: "Killing her parents, with her own words... eh."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「おそらく、口を開くとその時の恐怖を思い出
　されてしまうのでしょう」
dialogues.en: "However, please note that is my mere conjecture."
dialogues.text: "However, please note that is my mere conjecture."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「自分の言葉が誰かを傷つけてしまうのではな
　いか、お嬢様はそれを怖がっていらっしゃる
　のではないでしょうか」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. The first time I greeted the mistress, she was already
as reticient as she is now."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. The first time I greeted the mistress, she was already
as reticient as she is now."

dialogues.en: "The first time?"
dialogues.text: "The first time?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そんな過去があったとは……」
dialogues.en:
"Then, when Tsukishiro Kyouji died, you found out that he
had a daughter."
dialogues.text:
"Then, when Tsukishiro Kyouji died, you found out that he
had a daughter."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「自分が親を殺したと思ってるなんて……」
dialogues.en: "Hah, see? Sebastian agrees with me."
dialogues.text: "Hah, see? Sebastian agrees with me."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「杉並！　この間、お前が月城にしたこと、ちゃ
　んと謝れよ」
dialogues.en: "So she had that kind of past..."
dialogues.text: "So she had that kind of past..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……なぜ、謝る必要がある？　俺は間違った
　ことは言ってないつもりだが？」
dialogues.en:
"...Why are apologies needed? Have I said anything that has
been proven wrong, to her?"
dialogues.text:
"...Why are apologies needed? Have I said anything that has
been proven wrong, to her?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ただ、事情も知らずに、取った行動だったと
　いうのは、俺にしてはつまらんミスだ」
dialogues.en:
"The only slight mistake I made, was in the handling of the
situation, without knowing the cirumstances."
dialogues.text:
"The only slight mistake I made, was in the handling of the
situation, without knowing the cirumstances."

dialogues.jp:
柄になく、真面目な顔をする杉並。ヤツなりの
反省というところなのだろうか。
dialogues.en:
Although he remained firm, his face was serious. At least he
seemed to be reflecting on what he had done...
dialogues.text:
Although he remained firm, his face was serious. At least he
seemed to be reflecting on what he had done...

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「月城さんって、そのころから腹話術が得意だっ
　たんですか？　サーカスで覚えた芸とかで」
dialogues.en:
"Is that how Tsukishiro-san became so good at ventriloquism?
I've heard it used in some circus acts..."
dialogues.text:
"Is that how Tsukishiro-san became so good at ventriloquism?
I've heard it used in some circus acts..."

dialogues.jp: 『いえ』と瀬場さんが首を横に振る。
dialogues.en:
All of us leaned forward instinctively. We all seemed to be
extremely interested in the connection between Tsukishiro
and the doll.
dialogues.text:
All of us leaned forward instinctively. We all seemed to be
extremely interested in the connection between Tsukishiro
and the doll.

dialogues.jp:
月城が初音島に来てから１年くらい過ぎた頃
……今から４年くらい前から、月城が人形を
持つと人形が気持ちを喋るようになった、と。
dialogues.en:
"The mistress would carry the doll, and the doll would speak
of Tsukishiro's feelings for her."
dialogues.text:
"The mistress would carry the doll, and the doll would speak
of Tsukishiro's feelings for her."

dialogues.jp:
そして、それは月城が素手で人形を触っている
ときにだけ起こることらしい。
dialogues.en: "What about the gloves?"
dialogues.text: "What about the gloves?"

dialogues.jp:
手袋をしていれば、人形は喋らない、というこ
とだ。
dialogues.en:
"It appears that the doll speaks whenever the mistress holds
it with her bare hands, whether she wishes it to, or not."
dialogues.text:
"It appears that the doll speaks whenever the mistress holds
it with her bare hands, whether she wishes it to, or not."

dialogues.jp:
そういえば、人形が喋る時だけ、手袋を外し、
喋り終わると、またはめてたな。
dialogues.en:
Now that he said it, whenever the gloves came off, the doll
started talking, and whenever they were put back on, it
stopped.
dialogues.text:
Now that he said it, whenever the gloves came off, the doll
started talking, and whenever they were put back on, it
stopped.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「でも、そんな魔法みたいな事って、あり得ま
　すかね……」
dialogues.en:
"But that sounds so much like magic... I wonder whether it's
true..."
dialogues.text:
"But that sounds so much like magic... I wonder whether it's
true..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「自己暗示の一種だろう」
dialogues.en: "It could be a form of self-suggestion."
dialogues.text: "It could be a form of self-suggestion."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「自己暗示？」
dialogues.en: "Self-suggestion?"
dialogues.text: "Self-suggestion?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そうだ。手袋を外している時に人形に触れば
　｛・・・／勝手に｝人形が自分の心を伝えてくれる、そう
　いう暗示だ」
dialogues.en:
"Indeed. In other words, when she holds the doll with her
bare hands, the doll instantly pipes out with what she
felt."
dialogues.text:
"Indeed. In other words, when she holds the doll with her
bare hands, the doll instantly pipes out with what she
felt."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「自分でそれをしたっていうんですか？」
dialogues.en: "She's not actually doing it by herself?"
dialogues.text: "She's not actually doing it by herself?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いや、自己暗示というのは、自分で気が付か
　ないうちにかかっているものもある。強く思
　い込むことでな」
dialogues.en:
"It is very possible to do self-suggestion without even
realizing it. You just have to want it to happen enough."
dialogues.text:
"It is very possible to do self-suggestion without even
realizing it. You just have to want it to happen enough."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、ただ……人形を使って喋るようになっ
　たのが、初音島へ来てしばらくしてからとい
　うのが気になるがな」
dialogues.en:
"Although, most interestingly... apparently the doll would
only talk, after she started living in Hatsunejima.
dialogues.text:
"Although, most interestingly... apparently the doll would
only talk, after she started living in Hatsunejima.

dialogues.jp: 杉並が紅茶をすすりながら、そう言った。
dialogues.en: Suginami sipped his tea quietly, as he spoke.
dialogues.text: Suginami sipped his tea quietly, as he spoke.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「でも、問題はそんなことじゃあないですよね」
dialogues.en: "But the problem isn't that, anyway."
dialogues.text: "But the problem isn't that, anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そうだな。いつまでも自分の言葉で喋れない
　という訳にもいかないだろう」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. The bigger problem is that she doesn't talk,
herself."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. The bigger problem is that she doesn't talk,
herself."

dialogues.jp: それに、人形はもう壊れてしまった。
dialogues.en: And the doll has been more or less destroyed, too.
dialogues.text: And the doll has been more or less destroyed, too.

dialogues.jp:
月城と知り合ってから、彼女はだんだんと喋っ
てくれるようにはなっていた。
dialogues.en:
Since the first time I met her, she'd been slowly starting
to talk more.
dialogues.text:
Since the first time I met her, she'd been slowly starting
to talk more.

dialogues.jp:
俺はもっと月城と話がしたい。人形とではなく、
彼女と話がしたい。
dialogues.en: I want to talk more with her. Not with a doll, but with her.
dialogues.text: I want to talk more with her. Not with a doll, but with her.

dialogues.jp:
彼女の楽しいと思っていること、面白いと思っ
ていること、嫌だったこと、悲しかったこと、
dialogues.en:
The things she finds fun, the things she finds interesting.
The things she dislikes, the things she finds sad.
dialogues.text:
The things she finds fun, the things she finds interesting.
The things she dislikes, the things she finds sad.

dialogues.jp: それを彼女の口から聞きたい。
dialogues.en: I wanted to hear them from her mouth.
dialogues.text: I wanted to hear them from her mouth.

dialogues.jp:
妙にしんみりとしてしまった場の空気を取り繕
うようなタイミングで、瀬場さんは、月城の様
子を見てくると言って、部屋を出て行った。
dialogues.en:
Seiba-san departed the room, trying to ease the solemn mood,
while checking up on Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text:
Seiba-san departed the room, trying to ease the solemn mood,
while checking up on Tsukishiro.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「人形、壊れちゃったんなら、あまり月城さん
　とお話することができませんね……」
dialogues.en:
"Now that the doll isn't around anymore, Tsukishiro-san
would be talking even less now..."
dialogues.text:
"Now that the doll isn't around anymore, Tsukishiro-san
would be talking even less now..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そもそも人形で喋るというのがおかしいんだ」
dialogues.en:
"The doll talking, in the first place, is already strange to
begin with."
dialogues.text:
"The doll talking, in the first place, is already strange to
begin with."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「俺は、月城と話がしたいんだ」
dialogues.en: "I want to talk with Tsukishiro."
dialogues.text: "I want to talk with Tsukishiro."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉先輩」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura-senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura-senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「本音が出たな……」
dialogues.en: "Here comes the real motive..."
dialogues.text: "Here comes the real motive..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「な、何を言ってるんだ」
dialogues.en: "W, what are you saying..."
dialogues.text: "W, what are you saying..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、そうだとは思いましたけどね……」
dialogues.en: "Well, I thought this would happen..."
dialogues.text: "Well, I thought this would happen..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「わかりやすいヤツだからな」
dialogues.en: "You're so simple, my friend."
dialogues.text: "You're so simple, my friend."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ちょっと待て、お前ら！　別に深い意味なん
　てないぞ！　勝手に勘違いするな」
dialogues.en:
"Wait a minute, you two! Don't start reading between the
lines! You're obviously mistaken!"
dialogues.text:
"Wait a minute, you two! Don't start reading between the
lines! You're obviously mistaken!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「本当〜にわかりやすいな、わんこ嬢」
dialogues.en: "He's reaaaally~ easy to understand, dear puppy."
dialogues.text: "He's reaaaally~ easy to understand, dear puppy."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はい、わかりやすいです」
dialogues.en: "Eheheh. I agree!"
dialogues.text: "Eheheh. I agree!"

dialogues.jp: 美春が、たははと苦笑する。
dialogues.en: Miharu giggled lightly.
dialogues.text: Miharu giggled lightly.

dialogues.jp: なんなんだ、こいつらは……。
dialogues.en: What the hell, you two...
dialogues.text: What the hell, you two...

dialogues.jp: リビングの扉が、軽くノックされる。
dialogues.en:
A knock on the door of the living room then resounded
through the room.
dialogues.text:
A knock on the door of the living room then resounded
through the room.

dialogues.jp:
戻ってきた瀬場さんからは、月城の色好い返答
を聞くことは出来なかった。
dialogues.en: "We can't see her?"
dialogues.text: "We can't see her?"

dialogues.jp: まぁ、仕方ない……か。
dialogues.en: "Yes. She does not seem to be possess the mood for it."
dialogues.text: "Yes. She does not seem to be possess the mood for it."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、人形がないのでは、あまり喋ることも
　できんだろうからな」
dialogues.en:
"Well, without her doll, it's not like she's going to talk
anyway."
dialogues.text:
"Well, without her doll, it's not like she's going to talk
anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "...Suginami!!"
dialogues.text: "...Suginami!!"

dialogues.jp: ったく、よけいなことばかり言うヤツだ。
dialogues.en:
For God's sake, this guy does NOT know the meaning of "going
too far."
dialogues.text:
For God's sake, this guy does NOT know the meaning of "going
too far."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「果物かご、直接渡したかったんですけどね
　……」
dialogues.en: "I was hoping we could give her these fruits personally..."
dialogues.text: "I was hoping we could give her these fruits personally..."

dialogues.jp:
美春がそう言って、持ってきていた果物かごを
テーブルの上に置く。
dialogues.en:
Miharu looked at the fruits basket we had placed on the
table.
dialogues.text:
Miharu looked at the fruits basket we had placed on the
table.

dialogues.jp:
『私が責任を持ってお届けします』と言ってか
ごを受け取ろうとした瀬場さんの表情が、途中
から｛けげん／怪訝｝な顔つきになる。
dialogues.en:
As he took the basket and looked inside, his face turned to
one of disbelief.
dialogues.text:
As he took the basket and looked inside, his face turned to
one of disbelief.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「セバスチャンを｛うな／唸｝らすとは……」
dialogues.en: "Even Sebastian reacted like that..."
dialogues.text: "Even Sebastian reacted like that..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「え？　おかしいですか？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? It's weird?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? It's weird?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……全部バナナってのはナシだろう」
dialogues.en: "...It's all bananas."
dialogues.text: "...It's all bananas."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そういえば、そうですね。気を利かせてモン
　キーバナナやモラードバナナも混ぜておくべ
　きでしたね」
dialogues.en:
"I guess that's true. I should've mixed in some monkey
bananas and molard bananas."
dialogues.text:
"I guess that's true. I should've mixed in some monkey
bananas and molard bananas."

dialogues.jp: 結局、全部バナナかよッ！
dialogues.en: That's still all bananas, sheesh!"
dialogues.text: That's still all bananas, sheesh!"

dialogues.jp:
その日、俺達は、その後もしばらく瀬場さんと
一緒にお茶を楽しんだ。
dialogues.en:
We continued our enoyable conversation with Seiba-san for
the rest of the day.
dialogues.text:
We continued our enoyable conversation with Seiba-san for
the rest of the day.

dialogues.jp:
月城に会えなかったのは残念だったけど……彼
女にあんな過去があったなんて。
dialogues.en:
It's too bad that we couldn't see Tsukishiro... but we
managed to find out a lot about her past.
dialogues.text:
It's too bad that we couldn't see Tsukishiro... but we
managed to find out a lot about her past.

dialogues.jp: どうにか、できないものだろうか。
dialogues.en: Nothing we can do about it, though...
dialogues.text: Nothing we can do about it, though...

dialogues.jp: ◆月城の過去◆
dialogues.en: ◆Tsukishiro's Past◆
dialogues.text: ◆Tsukishiro's Past◆

dialogues.jp:
午後に、美春と……不本意だが杉並との３人で
月城の見舞いに行くことになった。
dialogues.en:
In the afternoon, I went with Miharu and... reluctantly,
Suginami, to visit Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text:
In the afternoon, I went with Miharu and... reluctantly,
Suginami, to visit Tsukishiro.

dialogues.jp:
だが、月城は休んでおり、俺達は会うことがで
きなかった。
dialogues.en: But Tsukishiro was resting, so we couldn't see her, anyway.
dialogues.text: But Tsukishiro was resting, so we couldn't see her, anyway.

dialogues.jp:
代わりに、俺達は、瀬場さんの口から月城の生
い立ちを聞かせてもらったのだった。
dialogues.en: Instead, we got to hear about her past through Seiba-san.
dialogues.text: Instead, we got to hear about her past through Seiba-san.

dialogues.jp:
そして、どうやら、子どもの頃に、自分の言葉
が両親を殺してしまったのだと思いこみ、自分
の言葉を使えなくなったのだという。
dialogues.en:
Apparently, she felt that she killed her parents with her
own words as a kid, so she refused to ever used her own
words again.
dialogues.text:
Apparently, she felt that she killed her parents with her
own words as a kid, so she refused to ever used her own
words again.

dialogues.jp:
その日、月城とは会うことができなかったが、
いろいろ知ることができた。
dialogues.en:
That day, we never saw Tsukishiro's face, but found out a
lot more about her.
dialogues.text:
That day, we never saw Tsukishiro's face, but found out a
lot more about her.

dialogues.jp: どうにか、してあげられないものだろうか。
dialogues.en: Nothing we can do about it, though...
dialogues.text: Nothing we can do about it, though...
